_about: How names and recurring terms are written in this language on Deovandski's site, so they are always spelled the same. Names are written by sound, never translated (the author's rule). #HusbandOutWorld names come from HusbandOutWorld's content/i18n/fr/glossary.json, which is the source: the names below are copied from it for the ones this site uses. Correct a series name there and here together, and look up any other series name there. Add this site's own names here the first time you translate them.
rule: Series names follow HusbandOutWorld's rule for this language: Story names stay exactly as in English, as in Portuguese, Spanish, Malay, German, Vietnamese and Italian. That includes coined world terms written as names: creatures, plants, items, nari gels, spells, factions, guilds, places, ranks and coins (Wood People, Sand Worms, Fost Stone, Nari Refresher, Red Winga, Sapphire, Pearl). Plain words around them are translated into French and follow French word order (gel nari, pierres nari, bombes nari, interface Darfaries, aventurier Sapphire). Kingdoms read 'Royaume de Sanbi', guards 'gardes de Forway'. The currency balls is 'boules' (singular 'boule'), which keeps the slang double meaning; the rank follows it (boule sapphire, boules pearl). The unit timehunk stays as is. The reader is addressed as 'tu' everywhere, matching the author's casual voice; profanity is kept. Dates put the day first: '994 A.G. Adrian 6th' becomes '6 Adrian 994 A.G.' (the 1st is '1er'); with a weekday, 'Gannday 14 Paulin 1039 A.G.'. Gregorian dates read '1er juin 2020'. French typography: a narrow no-break space (U+202F) before ! ? ; : and inside « », added outside HTML tags and URLs. Category labels shared between pages use forms that fit any gender: Pacifiques, Hostiles, Sur la défensive. 'Sanbi shit!' (the Sanbi oath) is always 'Vieille âme de Sanbi !' ('Old Sanbi soul!'), the author's rule; 'Sanbi shit out of luck' becomes 'Tu n'auras plus que la poisse, vieille âme de Sanbi !'. France French spelling.
site_rules: Real people and pets stay in Latin letters: Deovandski, Deo, and every family member, friend and pet named on the site (Peeta, Bidu, Fluffy).
Brand, company and product names stay as they are (Wizard Deo Solutions, Microsoft, Dynamics 365 F&O, GitHub, LinkedIn).

Titles in the top-39 lists (games, anime, TV, movies), concerts and theater (Deo's answer on #87): use the official title in this language. Movies and TV shows use their official local title; if none exists, keep the English one. Anime keeps the 'Romaji (local title)' structure; in Japanese, show the official Japanese title.
Anything marked translate="no" (Vraki-typeface text, names in a logo, code) stays as it is.
Every tab is translated, Lust, Tattoo and Mentor included (Deo's answer on #87).
